title: Ulta Beauty Announces Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2022 Results - Introduction
heading: Ulta Beauty Announces Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2022 Results
start_phrase: BOLINGBROOK, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Ulta Beauty, Inc. (NASDAQ: ULTA) today announced financial results for the thirteen-week period (“fourth quarter”) and fifty-two-week period (“fiscal year”) ended January 28, 2023 compared to the same periods ended January 29, 2022.
summary: Press release introducing Ulta Beauty’s fourth quarter and fiscal 2022 results, reporting Q4 net sales of $3.2268 billion versus $2.7294 billion, comparable sales up 15.6%, and net income of $340.8 million ($6.68 diluted EPS). A table provides 13- and 52-week metrics for 2023, 2022, and 2021: net sales; comparable sales growth (Q4 15.6%; FY 15.6%); gross profit as % of net sales (Q4 37.6%; FY 39.6%); SG&A expenses ($762.7 million Q4; $2.3953 billion FY); operating income as % of net sales (Q4 13.9%; FY 16.1%); diluted EPS ($6.68 Q4; $24.01 FY); and net new store openings (12 Q4; 47 FY). CEO Dave Kimbell highlights record milestones—annual revenue surpassing $10 billion, net income exceeding $1 billion, and more than 40 million Ultamate Rewards members—and expresses optimism for beauty category resilience and market share gains in fiscal 2023.

“Ulta Beauty’s strong fourth quarter results punctuate an exceptional year with record sales,
profitability, and member growth, reflecting robust demand and best-in-class execution,” said
Dave Kimbell, chief executive officer. “For the first time in our 33-year history, Ulta Beauty’s
annual revenue surpassed ten billion dollars, our annual net income exceeded one billion
dollars, and we exceeded 40 million Ultamate Rewards members. These milestone
achievements demonstrate the power of Ulta Beauty’s highly differentiated model, the health
of the growing beauty category, and our winning culture and outstanding teams.”
Kimbell continued, “As we move into fiscal 2023, we remain optimistic about the strength and
resiliency of the beauty category, and I am excited about the opportunities ahead to continue
to expand our leadership position, capture market share gains, and drive long term value for
all our stakeholders.”

title: For the Fourth Quarter of Fiscal 2022
heading: For the Fourth Quarter of Fiscal 2022
start_phrase: Net sales increased 18.2% to $3.2 billion compared to $2.7 billion in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2021 primarily due to the favorable impact from the continued resilience of the beauty category, retail price increases, and the impact of new brands and product innovation compared to the fourth quarter of fiscal 2021.
summary:
- Ulta Beauty’s March 9, 2023 press release announces fourth quarter and full-year fiscal 2022 results (periods ended January 28, 2023).
- Headline Q4 results: net sales $3.23B vs. $2.73B prior year; comparable sales +15.6%; net income $340.8M; diluted EPS $6.68.
- Full-year results: net sales $10.21B vs. $8.63B; comparable sales +15.6%; net income $1.24B; diluted EPS $24.01.
- Profitability metrics: Q4 gross margin 37.6% (flat YoY); operating margin 13.9% (vs. 13.8%). Full-year gross margin 39.6% (vs. 39.0%); operating margin 16.1% (vs. 15.0%).
- SG&A: Q4 $762.7M (23.6% of sales, down from 23.8%); full year $2.40B (23.5% of sales, down from 23.9%).
- Comparable sales drivers: Q4 transactions +13.6% and average ticket +1.8%; full year transactions +10.8% and average ticket +4.3%.
- Growth drivers cited: resilience of the beauty category, retail price increases, new brands and product innovation; plus increased social occasions and fewer COVID-19 limitations for the full year.
- Gross margin dynamics: leverage of fixed costs, favorable channel mix, and strong growth in other revenue; partially offset by higher inventory shrink (and lower merchandise margin for the full year).
- Expense dynamics: leverage in marketing and incentive compensation; partially offset by higher store payroll/benefits from wage investments and higher corporate overhead due to strategic investments.
- Tax rate higher YoY: Q4 24.6% (vs. 22.9%); full year 24.4% (vs. 23.9%).
- EPS details: Q4 $6.68 includes $0.02 tax benefit from stock-based comp (prior year included $0.05).
- Store growth: 12 net new stores in Q4; 47 net new stores in fiscal 2022.
- CEO commentary highlights record sales, profitability, and member growth; milestones include surpassing $10B in annual revenue, $1B in annual net income, and 40M+ Ultamate Rewards members.
- Outlook tone: optimism for fiscal 2023, with focus on expanding leadership, capturing market share, and creating long-term stakeholder value.
text:
For the Fourth Quarter of Fiscal 2022
Net sales increased 18.2% to $3.2 billion compared to $2.7 billion in the fourth quarter
of fiscal 2021 primarily due to the favorable impact from the continued resilience of the
beauty category, retail price increases, and the impact of new brands and product
innovation compared to the fourth quarter of fiscal 2021.Comparable sales (sales for stores open at least 14 months and e-commerce sales)
increased 15.6% compared to an increase of 21.4% in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2021,
driven by a 13.6% increase in transactions and a 1.8% increase in average ticket.
Gross profit increased 18.0% to $1.2 billion compared to $1.0 billion in the fourth
quarter of fiscal 2021. As a percentage of net sales, gross profit of 37.6% was flat
compared to the fourth quarter of fiscal 2021, primarily due to leverage of fixed costs,
favorable channel mix shifts, and strong growth in other revenue, offset by higher
inventory shrink.
Selling, general and administrative (SG&A) expenses increased 17.3% to $762.7
million compared to $650.0 million in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2021. As a percentage
of net sales, SG&A expenses decreased to 23.6% compared to 23.8% in the fourth
quarter of fiscal 2021, primarily due to leverage of marketing expenses and incentive
compensation due to higher sales, partially offset by deleverage of store payroll and
benefits due to wage investments and deleverage in corporate overhead due to
strategic investments.
Operating income increased 19.2% to $447.6 million, or 13.9% of net sales, compared
to $375.6 million, or 13.8% of net sales, in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2021.
The tax rate increased to 24.6% compared to 22.9% in the fourth quarter of fiscal
2021.
Net income increased 17.8% to $340.8 million compared to $289.4 million in the fourth
quarter of fiscal 2021.
Diluted earnings per share increased 23.5% to $6.68, including a $0.02 benefit due to
income tax accounting for stock-based compensation, compared to $5.41 including a
$0.05 benefit due to income tax accounting for stock-based compensation, in the fourth
quarter of fiscal 2021.

title: For the Full Year of Fiscal 2022
heading: For the Full Year of Fiscal 2022
start_phrase: Net sales increased 18.3% to $10.2 billion compared to $8.6 billion in fiscal 2021, primarily due to the favorable impact from the continued resilience of the beauty category, retail price increases, the impact of new brands and product innovation, increased social occasions, and fewer COVID-19 limitations compared to fiscal 2021.
summary:
- Q4 FY2022 performance:
  - Comparable sales up 15.6% (transactions +13.6%, average ticket +1.8%).
  - Gross profit up 18.0% to $1.2B; gross margin flat at 37.6% (fixed cost leverage, favorable channel mix, other revenue growth offset by higher inventory shrink).
  - SG&A up 17.3% to $762.7M; SG&A rate improved to 23.6% (marketing and incentive comp leverage) offset by wage investments and strategic corporate investments.
  - Operating income up 19.2% to $447.6M (13.9% margin).
  - Tax rate 24.6% (vs. 22.9%).
  - Net income up 17.8% to $340.8M.
  - Diluted EPS up 23.5% to $6.68, including a $0.02 tax benefit from stock-based compensation.

- Full-year FY2022 results:
  - Net sales up 18.3% to $10.2B, driven by beauty category resilience, price increases, new brands/innovation, more social occasions, and fewer COVID-19 constraints.
  - Comparable sales up 15.6% (transactions +10.8%, average ticket +4.3%).
  - Gross profit up 20.1% to $4.0B; gross margin up to 39.6% (fixed cost leverage, other revenue, channel mix), partially offset by higher shrink and lower merchandise margin.
  - SG&A up 16.2% to $2.4B; SG&A rate improved to 23.5% (lower marketing and incentive comp leverage), partially offset by wage and strategic corporate investments.
  - Operating income up 26.3% to $1.6B (16.1% margin).
  - Tax rate 24.4% (vs. 23.9%).
  - Net income up 26.0% to $1.2B.
  - Diluted EPS up 33.5% to $24.01, including a $0.07 tax benefit from stock-based compensation.

- Balance sheet:
  - Cash and cash equivalents: $737.9M at Q4 end.
  - Merchandise inventories: $1.6B, up $104.2M (new stores, brand launches/expansions, cost increases).

- Share repurchases:
  - Q4: 722,457 shares for $328.1M.
  - FY2022: 2.2M shares for $900.0M.
  - $1.1B remaining under $2.0B authorization as of Jan 28, 2023.

- Store footprint and activity:
  - Q4: 12 new stores, 1 relocation, 12 remodels.
  - FY2022: 47 new stores, 12 relocations, 20 remodels.
  - Total stores: 1,355; 14.2M square feet at FY end.

- FY2023 outlook:
  - Net sales: $10.95B–$11.05B.
  - Comparable sales: +4% to +5%.
  - New stores (net): 25–30; remodels/relocations: 20–30.
  - Operating margin: 14.7%–15.0%.
  - Diluted EPS: $24.70–$25.40.
  - Share repurchases: ~ $900M.
  - Effective tax rate: ~24.6%.
  - Capital expenditures: $400M–$475M.
  - Depreciation and amortization: $245M–$250M.
text:
For the Full Year of Fiscal 2022
Net sales increased 18.3% to $10.2 billion compared to $8.6 billion in fiscal 2021,
primarily due to the favorable impact from the continued resilience of the beauty
category, retail price increases, the impact of new brands and product innovation,
increased social occasions, and fewer COVID-19 limitations compared to fiscal 2021.
Comparable sales increased 15.6% compared to an increase of 37.9% in fiscal 2021,
driven by a 10.8% increase in transactions and a 4.3% increase in average ticket.
Gross profit increased 20.1% to $4.0 billion compared to $3.4 billion in fiscal 2021. As
a percentage of net sales, gross profit increased to 39.6% compared to 39.0% in fiscal
2021, primarily due to leverage of fixed costs, strong growth in other revenue, and
favorable channel mix shifts, partially offset by higher inventory shrink and lower
merchandise margin.
SG&A expenses increased 16.2% to $2.4 billion compared to $2.1 billion in fiscal
2021. As a percentage of net sales, SG&A expenses decreased to 23.5% compared to
23.9% in fiscal 2021, primarily due to lower marketing expenses and leverage of
incentive compensation due to higher sales, partially offset by deleverage of corporate
overhead due to strategic investments and deleverage of store payroll and benefits
due to wage investments.
Operating income increased 26.3% to $1.6 billion, or 16.1% of net sales, compared to
$1.3 billion, or 15.0% of net sales, in fiscal 2021.
The tax rate increased to 24.4% compared to 23.9% in fiscal 2021.
Net income increased 26.0% to $1.2 billion compared to $985.8 million in fiscal 2021.Diluted earnings per share increased 33.5% to $24.01, including a $0.07 benefit due to
income tax accounting for stock-based compensation, compared to $17.98 including a
$0.13 benefit due to income tax accounting for stock-based compensation, in fiscal
2021.

About Ulta Beauty
At Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful. Ulta Beauty is the largest
U.S. beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care
products, hair care products and salon services. In 1990, the Company reinvented the
beauty retail experience by offering a new way to shop for beauty – bringing together All
Things Beauty, All in One Place
®

states and also distributes its products through its website, which includes a collection of
tips, tutorials, and social content. For more information, visit 
www.ulta.com
.

title: Ulta Beauty, Inc. Sales by Category
heading: Exhibit 6 Ulta Beauty, Inc. Sales by Category
start_phrase: The following tables set forth the approximate percentage of net sales by primary category:
summary:
- Ulta Beauty provides quarterly data for Fiscal 2022 showing steady growth in retail footprint: starting at 13,770,438 gross square feet in Q1 and ending at 14,200,403 in Q4. Each quarter added gross square feet from store openings/expansions (Q1: +90,905; Q2: +61,257; Q3: +151,730; Q4: +126,073) with no store closures reported.
- Exhibit 6 details net sales mix by category for the 13 weeks and 52 weeks ended January 28, 2023, compared with the prior-year periods:
  - 13 weeks: Cosmetics 40% (down from 41%), Haircare 20% (flat), Skincare 16% (up from 15%), Fragrance & bath 18% (flat), Services 3% (flat), Accessories & other 3% (flat).
  - 52 weeks: Cosmetics 42% (down from 43%), Haircare 21% (up from 20%), Skincare 17% (flat), Fragrance & bath 14% (flat), Services 3% (flat), Accessories & other 3% (flat).
- Source and contact details are provided, indicating this is part of an Ulta Beauty, Inc. disclosure/press release.
